summary: Lead Real Estate Co., Ltd, a Tokyo-based operative builder listed on Nasdaq via ADSs, furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 containing Exhibit 99.1, the notice of its 26th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders to be held September 29, 2026 at 11 a.m. JST at its Shibuya headquarters. Agenda items are routine: approval of the FY2026 business report and consolidated and non-consolidated financial statements (July 2025 to June 2026), appropriation of retained earnings, election of three directors, and amendment to officer retirement allowance regulations. No special-situation transaction is present; this maps to a routine annual meeting proxy circular. No vote recommendations beyond board proposals, no deal terms, no arbitrage angle.
